correctness.rationale: The printed Itô SDE dx=[mS/(a+S)-D]x dt+sigma*x dB gives dlog x=[mS/(a+S)-D-sigma^2/2]dt+sigma dB; Eq.(3.1) omits the -sigma^2/2 drift. For Y=log(S/S*), Z=log(x/x*), the inverse density change has determinant 1/(Sx), absent from source Thm3.1. Under the paper local affine OU approximation, stationary mean solves A mu+(0,-sigma^2/2)=0 and covariance solves A Sigma+Sigma A^T+diag(0,sigma^2)=0. At (S0,D,m,a)=(4,2,3,1), exact mu=(3sigma^2/4,-sigma^2) and Sigma=sigma^2[[9/16,-3/4],[-3/4,19/16]], both independently algebraically verified. Consequently Z~N(-sigma^2,19sigma^2/16), x is lognormal with E[x]=2exp(-13sigma^2/32) and mode=2exp(-35sigma^2/16). This concerns the linear approximation, never an exact nonlinear stationary law.
